ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, if $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$ with points $B$, $E$, $C$, and $F$ lying on the same straight line, and $BC=7$, $EC=4$, then what is the length of $CF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$ and $BC = 7$, \\
$\therefore EF = BC = 7$, \\
$\therefore CF = EF - EC = \boxed{3}$
